sources.name: Claude-Mem
sources.description: Search persistent observations, session summaries and their timeline in your installed memory worker.
sources.prerequisites: An installed, running worker. Its port depends on your user ID; use the address printed by the worker. Cloud sync, observer billing and capture remain controlled in Claude-Mem.

sources.name: OpenMausBot
sources.description: Use bot teams, channels, approvals, computers, voice and connected apps in the full companion.
sources.prerequisites: An installed desktop app or source harness and its configured agents. Packaged UI usually shares the API port; source UI usually uses port 5199. Paired MCP writes need upstream authentication.

sources.name: OpenBot
sources.description: Open your self-hosted coworkers, governed browser computers, routines, policy and audit workspace.
sources.prerequisites: A configured source deployment with Bun, Docker, PostgreSQL, model access and CopilotKit Intelligence configuration. Its health endpoint does not prove identity, authentication or model readiness. AG-UI is separate from MCP.
